Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000002488-26-000018, filed February 4, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-129057, ownership as of March 19, 2026). Lisa Su, Chair and CEO, beneficially owns 4,305,973 shares, less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null; the figure includes 413,529 shares under options exercisable within 60 days. 5% HOLDERS: the 2026 proxy still cites the same Schedule 13G filings of February 2024 (Vanguard Amendment No. 12, BlackRock Amendment No. 8), with percentages computed on the March 19, 2026 count of 1,630,338,779 shares; it gives no ownership dates, so holder asOf is null, and the share counts are stale. DIVIDENDS are 0: the cash-flow statement has no dividend line in financing activities (quoted), and the stock-option notes say the Company does not expect to pay dividends in the near future. Buybacks exclude $607 million of stock repurchased for tax withholding on employee equity plans. GEOGRAPHY is by customer billing location, as AMD reports it; in FY2025 AMD reports four named countries plus 'Other regions' (Japan and Europe are no longer shown separately). AMD sold the ZT Systems manufacturing business in 2025 and reports it as discontinued operations; the geographic table covers continuing net revenue.
